summary: Iteration 25: Tested 3 NEW backend endpoint groups (audit-log filters, qr-poster, pos extras: trial-reset/staff CRUD) and frontend wiring of SuperAppOverlay + page integrations on /taxi /scooter /food. Backend: 20/20 PASS. Frontend: /taxi and /scooter render SuperAppOverlay buttons (loyalty, plans, mic, safety) AND ARScooterFinder button correctly. /food CRASHES with runtime ReferenceError 'advFilters is not defined' — FoodPage.jsx is missing useState declarations for advFilters/setAdvFilters/showAdvFilters/setShowAdvFilters even though they are referenced at lines 415-421 and 1192-1196. This blocks rendering of the floating overlay AND the new food-adv-filters-btn / food-split-pay-btn / ReviewModal buttons on /food.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime ReferenceError: 'advFilters is not defined'. Variables `advFilters`, `setAdvFilters`, `showAdvFilters`, `setShowAdvFilters` are USED (lines 415-421, 1192-1196) but never declared via useState. This crashes the entire FoodPage rendering tree, so SuperAppOverlay (loyalty/plans/safety/mic), `food-adv-filters-btn`, `food-split-pay-btn`, FoodFilters bottom-sheet and ReviewModal are all NOT visible on /food.

action_items: FoodPage.jsx: Add the missing useState declarations near line 69, e.g. `const [showAdvFilters, setShowAdvFilters] = useState(false);` and `const [advFilters, setAdvFilters] = useState(null);` (or {} matching FoodFilters initial shape). Verify by reloading /food in the browser and observing no ReferenceError plus visible food-adv-filters-btn + SuperAppOverlay buttons.
After the fix, retest /food for: food-adv-filters-btn opens FoodFilters bottom-sheet, food-split-pay-btn opens SplitPaymentModal, and ReviewModal launches from delivered orders.
Optional: Add a CI lint rule (no-undef via ESLint) — this class of bug should fail the build.
critical_code_review_comments: FoodPage.jsx uses 4 undeclared identifiers (advFilters, setAdvFilters, showAdvFilters, setShowAdvFilters). ESLint with `react/jsx-no-undef` and `no-undef` would catch this immediately. Recommend adding lint to pre-commit/CI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend new-route tests (test_pos_extras_audit.py) are 20/20 green. Only FoodPage.jsx has a blocking React crash – `advFilters` / `setAdvFilters` / `showAdvFilters` / `setShowAdvFilters` are referenced but never declared via useState. /taxi and /scooter floating overlays + ARScooterFinder button render correctly when authenticated. To repro frontend tests: API-login as admin (POST /api/auth/login) which sets access_token cookie automatically in playwright context, then navigate to /food (will throw 'advFilters is not defined' in pageerror), /taxi (clean), /scooter (clean – AR Finder visible top-right). LiveChat / SplitPaymentModal / ReviewModal on TaxiPage tracking view require an active ride which we did not seed; verifying button rendering would require seeding a ride or mocking activeRideId.
rca of the issue: Main agent added new JSX referencing advFilters / showAdvFilters state at FoodPage.jsx lines 415-421 (button) and 1192-1196 (modal mount) but forgot to add the corresponding useState declarations near line 69 where all other FoodPage states are declared. Result: at first render, JS evaluates the button's className ternary which references `advFilters`, hitting a ReferenceError that unmounts the entire page tree. This is why the SuperAppOverlay also disappears on /food (it is rendered by AppContent which is fine, but the crashing FoodPage component throws before AppContent's tree mounts the overlay portal — actually the overlay is a sibling, so its non-rendering specifically on /food is because the ReferenceError originates inside the FoodPage subtree but there is no error boundary, causing the React app root to fail to commit). Fix: add `const [showAdvFilters, setShowAdvFilters] = useState(false);` and `const [advFilters, setAdvFilters] = useState(null);` (or `{}` matching whatever FoodFilters expects as initial value).
